name: gas_turbine_inlet_air_chiller
title: Gas turbine with a chiller on the compressor inlet air
summary: Open-cycle Brayton plant (compressor, adiabatic combustor, expander, methane in air) whose inlet air at 30 C is cooled to 20 C by an R134a refrigeration machine sized against the compressor reduced-flow constraint: the evaporator UA and the chiller compressor displacement come out of the model, and the global efficiency includes the chiller power.
language_features: user-library routines cpbar and gamma (implicit library, copied in from CSL-0005)
property functions (Air, CH4, R134a and ideal-gas species)

origin.course: MECA0006 Machines et systèmes thermiques (ULiège), repetition R12, exercise 7

verification.summary: Stored solution of MSTH-SB-R12-EX7.EES (EES X7.458). compare_solution.py: 78 common variables, 20 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 26. The R134a h/s reference offsets (h_1..h_4, s_1) and the cp(CH4)/cp(Air) backend differences (largest cp_f 8.77e-3) explain the flagged variables; everything else within 1e-3, including AU_ev 3.67e-4, V_s 6.80e-4, eta 9.43e-4.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of MSTH-SB-R12-EX7.EES (78 numeric values, EES X7.458), compared with tools/compare_solution.py
verification.notes: The tool prints a maximum of 5.61e-01 (h_3 and h_4) over all common variables: the six flagged R134a absolute h/s variables (h_1..h_4, s_1) carry the constant CoolProp-vs-EES reference offsets (+148.1 kJ/kg, +0.796 kJ/kg-K; all uses in the model are differences). The remaining 14 flagged variables are CoolProp-vs-EES Air/CH4 cp differences (cp_f 8.77e-3 largest, q_2 9.84e-3, cp_a 2.45e-3, W_dot_sh/W_dot_el 2.02e-3); everything else within 1e-3. The 26 CoolSolve-only names are the 8 unused cpbar CALL outputs and the 18 state-point post-processing variables. Converges from default guesses (61 iterations); .initials supplied for convenience.
